device: CPU only, nice -n 19, container <= 32 GB, wait when host memory use > 80 %

inputs.patch_values: JC geometry_raw/<tile>__<prior>.npz (n, mvs_sd_m, mvs_mean_m, mvs_median_m, mvs_face_m, d_m, area, kind, region, building, surf, centre, normal, prior_height_m), JC geometry/base (u_M, sigma_P, sigma_W, r_m, L_m, geometry), JC judge/base (region[8], reason[8], target_h[8], photo_code, photo_point, s_P, s_M, t), JC place, JC texture, JC sight
inputs.photo_point_values: JC photo_prepared/<tile>.npz (source_index, prior, kind, area, all_within, available, selected_images, mvs_fit_count, mvs_fit_nmad_m, mvs_normal_angle_deg, mask_fraction_at_zero, centres, normals) + JC photo_scores/<tile>/scores.npz (score, texture, valid_image_count); photo point -> patches via JC photo_groups patch_point
inputs.gt_point_values: JC analysis/gt_<prior>.npz (case, s_P, s_M, tau, gid, place, target_ok_v, target_distance_v, region_v, patch_majority_case ...) and analysis/patches_<prior>.npz majority_counts (cases 0..4 per patch, gid order = sorted geometry_raw tiles)

definitions.patch_case: argmax of JC majority_counts (GT points of the patch, current-definition cases 0..4; 3 = outside four cases); patches without GT points have no case
definitions.mixed_patch: share of the majority case < 0.80 (order 0.3; differs from JUDGECHECK-v2 mixed_patch_flag, which is point-level)
definitions.no_uM_patch: n >= 4, finite prior and MVS height, geometry code 9 and u_M not finite (11/4 rule) - counted on its own row
definitions.area_weight: patch area (JC geometry_raw area, m2); target-ok and name-ok % are GT point shares as in JUDGECHECK-v2 s7_tables
definitions.photo_point_to_patch: every member patch receives the values of its photo point (judge/base photo_point -> photo_prepared row with source_index == photo_point and same prior)

candidates.name: n
candidates.def: MVS points in the cylinder (geometry_raw n)

candidates.name: mvs_sd
candidates.def: SD of MVS heights in the cylinder (geometry_raw mvs_sd_m)

candidates.name: fit_nmad
candidates.def: MVS plane fit residual NMAD (photo_prepared mvs_fit_nmad_m)

candidates.name: fit_count
candidates.def: points used in the MVS plane fit (photo_prepared mvs_fit_count)

candidates.name: plane_angle
candidates.def: angle between MVS plane and prior normal, deg (photo_prepared mvs_normal_angle_deg)

candidates.name: s_P
candidates.def: photo score of the prior plane (photo_scores score[:,0])

candidates.name: s_M
candidates.def: photo score of the MVS plane (score[:,1])

candidates.name: views_min
candidates.def: valid image count used in scoring, min of the two planes (scores valid_image_count); prior and MVS values also kept as 10a views_P, 10b views_M

candidates.name: texture_min
candidates.def: texture strength, min of the two pieces (scores texture); 11a texture_P, 11b texture_M kept

candidates.name: mask_frac_min
candidates.def: remaining sample (trimmed mask) fraction, min of the two planes (photo_prepared mask_fraction_at_zero); 12a, 12b kept

candidates.name: face_minus_mean
candidates.def: mvs_face_m - mvs_mean_m (outer-face height minus mean; stored geometry_raw column linked to MVS quality, added before first computation)

candidates.name: n10_over_n
candidates.def: n10 / n (MVS points within the wider stored count n10 relative to n; stored geometry_raw column, added before first computation)

check_ga.targets: outside-limit patches with a patch case 0, 1 or 2; versions: excluding mixed patches and including them; no-uM patches on their own row
check_ga.auc: area-weighted Mann-Whitney AUC = P(x_imgerr > x_other) + 0.5 P(tie), weights = area products; two AUCs: image-depth error vs prior error, image-depth error vs both valid; discrimination = |AUC - 0.5|; ranking key = mean of the two |AUC - 0.5| (excluding-mixed version)
check_ga.five_percent: per search region x unit: area-weighted 5 % and 95 % of the observation over inside-limit patches (no GT used; all inside-limit patches regardless of GT presence); region 'none' pooled over the seven search regions; below 5 % = low reject, above 95 % = high reject; rejection share = area share of the case
check_ga.pairs: five observations with the largest ranking key per unit; ten pairs; reject when either observation rejects (either side)
check_ga.splits_in_files: place (면 안쪽, 면 경계, 건물 가장자리) and texture-less (GTJUDGE rule, JC texture) x the AUC and rejection shares

check_na.t_M: JC s5_judge rule on s_M: photo points whose members are all inside L (base), per search region x prior x kind, area-weighted lower 5 %, > 5000 -> random 5000 with the same seed list as t; 'none' pooled
check_na.variant_ga: photo code with s_P vs t and s_M vs t_M (support = s_P >= t and s_M < t_M; refute = s_P < t and s_M >= t_M; both low; both high), other codes and the order 7 > 6 > 4 > 5 unchanged; then JC decide and target_height; GT target-ok recomputed only for patches whose method target changed (JC s4_truth_exp.plane_distance)
check_na.check: base recomputed from stored values must reproduce JC judge/base method region (100 %) and the c1 case summary target-ok values
check_na.rows: base and variant ga; prior only, image only, oracle (patch majority upper bound) as stored

check_da.survey: tool, version, command and options from WIDEN0 mvs/full (colmap_receipt.json, container_launch.json, patch_match.log, stereo/patch-match.cfg), point producer scripts/phd/main_widen0_v2/mvs_points.py; file counts, sizes, resolution
check_da.multi_view: only search region B0; photo points of B0 buildings; X = MVS plane centre (photo_prepared centres[:,1]); views = selected_images[:,1] (MVS-plane photo selection); z = camera axial depth of X in WIDEN0 pose (Cameras.M, K, 1024 x 741); D = geometric depth at rint pixel; observations: share of views with |D - z| / z <= 1 % (also 0.5 %, 2 %), median |D - z|; counted like check ga (added rows)
check_da.budget: skip 5.2 if the estimate exceeds 2 hours

check_ra.mde: 2.80 * sqrt(u_M^2 + sigma_P^2 + sigma_W^2) + |r| per patch (inside and outside limit, finite u_M)
check_ra.inside_agree_error_points: GT points with method region 0 via geometry code 0, case in 1, 2, 4, target outside tau (JC 6.3 true error, inside-L agree rule); share with |s_P - s_M| < patch MDE; split by mixed patch

recount.1: roof faces (LoD2 surf, ALS face of JC place) per building: median s_P and s_M of case-0 GT points; first DEBY_LOD2_4959460, 4906982, 4907509 (suffix match), then all; flag faces holding GT member rows of JC clusters with geometry_type '두 자료가 같은 쪽으로 어긋남'
recount.2: drop GT points with |s_P| or |s_M| in [0.8 tau, 1.2 tau]; target-ok % per case for method, prior only, image only, oracle; with and without the drop
recount.3: LoD2 case 0, method region 2 (use image), target outside tau: diff = target distance (GT point to the cylinder-height plane, stored) - s_M; distribution, share |diff| > tau
recount.4: photo code 7 (photo shortage) GT points: roof / wall x short side (prior plane < 3 views, MVS plane < 3, both); GT cell area and share per case
recount.5: 20 more '윤곽 밖의 새 면' clusters by area after the ones in JUDGECHECK-v2 figure 6 (same layout); first to drop when late
recount.6: inside-L agree true error points: patch L / tau distribution, share L > tau, cross table with mixed patch

figures.fig1: per prior: per observation boxes of the three cases (outside limit, excluding mixed) + inside-limit both-valid reference, ordered by ranking key
figures.fig2: per prior, the two observations with the largest ranking key (LoD2 ranked on LoD2 roof+wall pooled AUC): image-depth-error patches (excluding mixed), six rejected + six not rejected; patches connected within 0.36 m per building; components by area descending; at most two per building; panel (a) oblique training image (JC s10_images.oblique_view rule) with the component patches, (b) section through the component's largest patch centre along tangent1 x normal, +-0.15 m slab, +-3 m: GT points, prior plane line, MVS points, MVS plane line
figures.fig3: per prior: target-ok % per case for base, variant ga, prior only, image only, oracle
figures.fig4: per prior: MDE distribution by place with region tau marks
